Name: DE-ProjectsCount
Description: Gets the count of projects for the provided filters.
Statement:
select  count(*) as [Count]
from    ProjectLookup prj
            left join Project pjt on pjt.Oid = prj.Id
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = prj.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
where   wst.Status not in (1) and
        (@ModifiedFrom is null or pjt.ModifiedOn >= @ModifiedFrom) and
        (@ProjectId is null or prj.Id = @ProjectId) and
        (@ProjectNumber is null or prj.Number = cast(@ProjectNumber as nvarchar))
